subject: CS243
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. For Arabic, strong candidates were found for Kleene's Theorem, P vs NP, and Regular Sets. However, no suitable Arabic-language videos were available for 'Designing Turing Machines' and 'The Halting Problem'; all candidates for these topics were either irrelevant or in English.

videos.title: DFA to Regular Expression Conversion
videos.filter_reason: This is a perfect, concise explanation of DFA to RE conversion with a massive view count, directly addressing the practical algorithm students struggle with.

videos.title: Lec-60: Turing Machine for a^nb^n | Design Turing Machine
videos.topic_en: Designing Turing Machines to Recognize Sets
videos.topic_ar: تصميم آلات تورينج للتعرف على المجموعات
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a very clear, step-by-step design of a Turing Machine for the classic a^n b^n language, which is an ideal example for learning the low-level logic.

videos.title: Turing & The Halting Problem - Computerphile
videos.filter_reason: Computerphile excels at making abstract topics intuitive; this video's explanation of the self-referential paradox is ideal for grasping this difficult concept.

videos.title: 8. NP-Hard and NP-Complete Problems
videos.filter_reason: Abdul Bari provides a famously clear and in-depth lecture on NP-Hardness and NP-Completeness, thoroughly explaining the concept of reductions which is a key student struggle.

videos.title: Regular Languages
videos.filter_reason: This Neso Academy video gives a clear, foundational definition of what constitutes a regular language, which is the essential first step to proving regularity.

videos.title: #13 نظريه الحوسبه شرح ال    (1) Kleene's theorem
videos.filter_reason: This is the first part of a dedicated Arabic series on Kleene's theorem, with good viewership, making it an excellent and focused starting point for the topic.

videos.title: الخوارزميات 4  | جحيم التعقيد الحسابي (حلقة خاصة)
videos.filter_reason: A highly-viewed and well-produced video that specifically focuses on the P vs NP problem in Arabic, featuring an expert on the topic.

videos.title: نظرية الحوسبة١: Intro to DFA
videos.filter_reason: With an exceptionally high view count, this video is the definitive Arabic introduction to DFAs and how they recognize regular languages, perfectly matching the topic.
